title: LINZ Topo50 topographic map of Ongaonga, 2020
credit: Land Information New Zealand; Topo50 sheet BL37 Ongaonga
altText: Colour LINZ Topo50 map showing Ongaonga and surrounding roads, contours and features.
caption: Section of the LINZ Topo50 map for Ongaonga, derived from sheet BL37, showing modern topographic cartography.
context: An actual LINZ digital-era topographic product useful for comparison with the paper NZMS series. The image represents 2020 mapping, not the initial NZMS260 conversion in 1977.
